ingest.purpose: Get a carrier’s quarterly IFTA fuel tax return built from complete, verified fuel and mileage records, approved by the client, filed by AIO, and archived — every quarter.
ingest.promise: AIO handles the quarter: you send fuel and miles as they happen, AIO checks, reconciles, files and keeps the record.
ingest.primary_task: Send fuel and miles; resolve flags; approve
ingest.client_founder_mirror: Staff see the same quarter as a CASE FILE across many clients: due-date × readiness queue, flag counts, MPG / jurisdiction discrepancies, override + audit trail, payment status — not the client’s guided packet builder.

experience_contract.emotional_target: I know exactly what AIO needs from me — and that the quarter is under control.
experience_contract.primary_visual_object: THE QUARTER (Q{n} {YYYY} — due date, packet completeness, seal when filed)

composition_rules: The quarter object leads every client state; receipts / mileage / vehicles are its three compartments, never three equal dashboard cards.
Exactly one primary action per state (CONTINUE FILING · RESOLVE n ITEMS · SEND QUARTER TO AIO · APPROVE RETURN · VIEW IN VAULT).
Flags sit inside the compartment they belong to, with the fix action inline.
Estimated mileage is visually distinct (stone, “ESTIMATE”) and can never look filed-ready.
Review states quiet the inputs and foreground who is working and what happens next.
Completion collapses the workbench into a sealed quarter that visibly moves to the Vault.

viewport_targets.note: Mobile = capture-first task flow at the pump; desktop = packet workbench. Never shrink the desktop bench into mobile.

MOBILE.task_model: capture-first task flow: snap receipts at the pump, resolve one flag at a time, approve in one decision window
MOBILE.layout: quarter header (state · % · due) → single next action → compartments as collapsible rows → sticky TAKE PHOTO / CONTINUE
MOBILE.primary_object_treatment: quarter card pinned at top with a completeness ring
MOBILE.input_treatment: camera + upload as full-width primary; mileage source picker as a sheet

TABLET.task_model: review-and-resolve: compartments side by side, flags resolved in place
TABLET.layout: quarter header + two-column compartments (receipts | mileage) with vehicles strip
TABLET.primary_object_treatment: quarter header with timeline of the six steps

DESKTOP.task_model: workbench: build and check the packet with everything visible
DESKTOP.layout: left: quarter + six-step progress; centre: active compartment (receipt grid / mileage table by state × truck); right: flags + messages
DESKTOP.primary_object_treatment: quarter as the bench object with compartments as tabs of one packet
DESKTOP.input_treatment: bulk upload, ELD report upload, spreadsheet mapping
